title: Fractions Addition - Level 4: Word Problems
description: Solve real-world problems involving fraction addition

questions.question: Sarah ate 1/4 of a pizza and her brother ate 2/4 of the same pizza. How much pizza did they eat together?
A recipe calls for 1/2 cup of flour and 1/4 cup of sugar. How many cups of ingredients is that total?
John ran 2 1/2 miles on Monday and 1 1/2 miles on Tuesday. How many miles did he run total?
questions.explanation: Add whole numbers: 2+1=3. Add fractions: 1/2+1/2=1. Total: 4 miles

questions.question: A baker used 2/3 kg of flour for bread and 1/6 kg for cookies. How much flour did he use total?
In a class, 1/3 of students play football and 1/2 play basketball. What fraction plays either sport? (Assume no one plays both)
Amy walked 2/5 mile to the park and then 3/10 mile to the library. How far did she walk total?
A cake requires 2 1/3 cups of flour and 1 2/3 cups of sugar. How many total cups of dry ingredients?
Tom painted 3/8 of a fence on Saturday and 2/8 on Sunday. How much of the fence did he paint?
A jug had 7/8 liter of juice. Mary poured in another 3/8 liter. How much juice is in the jug now?
Sally read 1/4 of a book on Monday and 2/4 on Tuesday. What fraction of the book has she read?
A carpenter cut 1/2 foot off a board and then 1/3 foot off another board. What is the total length cut?
questions.explanation: Convert 1/2 to 3/6 and 1/3 to 2/6. Add: 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6 ft

questions.question: A farmer has 2 3/4 acres of corn and 1 1/4 acres of wheat. How many total acres does he have?
Maria filled her car with 12 1/2 gallons of gas. She used 3 1/2 gallons for a trip. How much gas is left?
questions.explanation: 12 1/2 - 3 1/2 = 9 gallons (but the question incorrectly asks for addition - let's fix) Correction: This should be addition. Let's rephrase: Maria bought 12 1/2 gallons last week and 3 1/2 gallons this week. Total = 12+3=15, 1/2+1/2=1, 15+1=16 gallons

questions.question: A recipe needs 2/3 teaspoon of salt and 1/6 teaspoon of pepper. What is the total?
In a survey, 1/4 of people liked tea and 3/8 liked coffee. What fraction liked either? (Assume no overlap)
A pipe is 3 2/5 meters long. Another pipe is 2 3/5 meters long. When joined, how long are they?
Jake ate 1/6 of a cake and his sister ate 1/3. How much did they eat together?
A construction crew built 5/8 mile of road on Monday and 2/8 mile on Tuesday. How much total?
A bathtub was 2/3 full. Then 1/6 more water was added. How full is it now?
Lisa spent 1 1/2 hours on homework and 2 1/2 hours on chores. How many total hours?
A tank had 3/4 of water. A rain barrel added 1/8. How much water now?
Sam bought 2 3/8 kg of apples and 3 5/8 kg of oranges. Total weight?
A pitcher had 5/6 liter of lemonade. Another 2/6 liter was added. How much now?
In a garden, 2/5 are roses and 3/10 are tulips. What fraction are roses or tulips?
A student spent 1/3 hour on math and 1/2 hour on science. Total study time?
questions.explanation: Convert 1/3 to 2/6 and 1/2 to 3/6. Add: 2/6 + 3/6 = 5/6 hr

questions.question: A board is 2 3/4 feet long. Another board is 1 1/4 feet long. Total length?
A recipe used 1/4 cup of oil and 3/8 cup of water. Total liquid?
Mike drove 3 1/3 miles to the store and 2 2/3 miles back. Total miles?
A jug had 7/12 gallon of milk. Another 3/12 gallon was added. How much now?
In a school, 1/5 of students play soccer and 3/10 play baseball. Fraction playing either?
A painter used 2 1/6 gallons of paint on one room and 1 5/6 gallons on another. Total paint?
A rope was 3/4 meter long. Another 2/4 meter was added. How long now?
A recipe needs 1/3 cup of milk and 1/4 cup of cream. Total liquid?
questions.explanation: Convert 1/3 to 4/12 and 1/4 to 3/12. Add: 4/12 + 3/12 = 7/12 cup

questions.question: A farmer picked 4 3/5 baskets of apples and 3 2/5 baskets of pears. Total baskets?
A tank had 5/8 of water. A storm added 3/8. Now how full is it?
A baker used 1 1/2 kg of flour for bread and 2 1/2 kg for cakes. Total flour?
In a city, 2/7 of people have dogs and 3/14 have cats. Fraction with either pet?
A student read 3/4 of a book last week and 1/8 this week. Total read?
A carpenter has two boards: 2 3/8 ft and 3 5/8 ft. Total length?
A pitcher had 4/5 liter of juice. Another 1/10 liter was added. Total now?
A hiker climbed 2 1/4 miles up and then 1 3/4 miles down a different path. Total hiked?
A recipe used 2/3 teaspoon of salt and 1/6 teaspoon of pepper. Total spices?
In a survey, 3/8 of people preferred tea and 1/4 preferred coffee. Fraction preferring either?
A tank had 7/10 of water. A pipe added 2/10. How much now?
A runner went 3 1/3 km in the morning and 2 2/3 km in the evening. Total?
A cake needs 1/2 cup of oil and 1/3 cup of water. Total liquid?
questions.explanation: Convert 1/2 to 3/6 and 1/3 to 2/6. Add: 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6 cup
